talents.name: Library Use
talents.text: You learn more from everything you play and from turning up

talents.name: Marginalia
talents.text: A chance of one more Necronomicon Page whenever you get Pages

talents.name: Occult
talents.text: Riddles pay more Madness, and lore teaches you more (riddles, prophecies, bounties, dreams)

talents.name: Dream-Lore
talents.text: Your Dreamland quests go a little better

talents.name: Thesis
talents.text: The Esoteric Order thinks more of what you do: reputation comes faster

talents.name: Forbidden Margins
talents.text: Your spells need less Void Dust

talents.name: Cthulhu Mythos
talents.text: Capstone: you learn more from everything you play, and far more from lore. You know too much.

talents.name: Spot Hidden
talents.text: Curios turn up more often in the Delve

talents.name: Luck
talents.text: Your gambles win a little more often

talents.name: Psychology
talents.text: The Merchant from Leng gives you a better price

talents.name: Keen Ear
talents.text: Banishing a Being pays more, and you get a moment longer to grab a goblin or cast into the Wreckage: you hear it coming

talents.name: Patient Angler
talents.text: Your Fishing skill rises faster

talents.name: Push the Roll
talents.text: Once a stream, a lost gamble is rolled again. If the second roll loses too, it costs you more

talents.name: Lucky Find
talents.text: Capstone: many more curios in the Delve, more Madness from won gambles, and the Wreckage hauls you up two things

talents.name: Dodge
talents.text: Better odds in Delve fights and in duels

talents.name: Fighting
talents.text: You hit Elite Beings and the Stars' Old One harder

talents.name: First Aid
talents.text: A chance that a lost Delve fight costs you no wound

talents.name: Swim
talents.text: Dying in the Delve costs you less of the run's XP

talents.name: Steady Hands
talents.text: Your Delve gear wears out more slowly

talents.name: Warded
talents.text: Better odds in duels, and your Ward catches more of a loss

talents.name: Will to Live
talents.text: Capstone: a good chance that a lost Delve fight costs no wound, and a death keeps much more of the run's XP

talents.name: Tenure
talents.text: The start of every stream teaches you more

talents.name: Sea Legs
talents.text: One more catch on every cast while the Wreckage drifts in

talents.name: Second Circle
talents.text: One more ritual slot

talents.name: Triage
talents.text: Heal a friend's Delve wound once a stream

talents.name: Stargazer
talents.text: You hit the Stars' Old One harder and learn more from lore

occupations.name: Antiquarian
occupations.text: Curios turn up more often in the Delve, and you fight well with relics and against the Restless Dead. Bane: thrown weapons, and Orcs and Trolls

occupations.name: Journalist
occupations.text: You learn more from riddles, prophecies, bounties and dreams, banished Beings pay a little more, and you fight Sorcerers well. Bane: the cults know your face

occupations.name: Private Eye
occupations.text: Banishing a Being pays you more Madness, and you fight well with ranged weapons and against Cultists. Banes: the Dreamlands, and you lack the patience to fish

occupations.name: Professor
occupations.text: You learn more from playing and turning up, and you fight well with spells and against Sorcerers. Banes: melee, and Orcs and Trolls

occupations.name: Dilettante
occupations.text: Won gambles and won descents pay you more, and Treasure Goblins don't get away from you. Banes: your Delve gear wears faster, and melee

occupations.name: Occultist
occupations.text: Your spells need less Void Dust, and you fight well with spells and summons. Banes: the Outer Court notices you, and rival cults hate you

occupations.name: Sailor
occupations.text: Dying in the Delve costs you less XP, your Fishing skill rises faster, the sea gives you rarer fish and you fight Deep Ones well. Banes: fresh water, and Burrowers

occupations.name: Doctor
occupations.text: A chance that a lost Delve fight costs you no wound, and you fight well against the Restless Dead and the Mi-Go. Bane: Ghouls smell the morgue on you

lineages.name: Human
lineages.text: You learn a little more from playing and turning up, and your oath strengthens a raid. Bane: strange waters

lineages.name: Deep One Hybrid
lineages.text: Rare fish find your line more often, more so at sea, and Deep Ones go easy on kin. Banes: fresh water, and Flame and Frost

lineages.name: Ghoul
lineages.text: Pickman eats less of your hauls, and you fight well against Ghouls and the Restless Dead. Banes: Flame and Frost, and holy relics

lineages.name: Cat of Ulthar
lineages.text: Dreamland quests go better for you, you fight the Dreamlands well and fresh water gives you rarer fish. Banes: Deep Ones (wet), and Beasts and Fey

lineages.name: Whateley-Blood
lineages.text: Your spells need less Void Dust, and you fight well with summons and against Sorcerers. Banes: the dogs howl at you, and the Merchant charges you more

lineages.name: Serpent Folk
lineages.text: You win duels a little more often, and you fight well with spells and against N'kai. Bane: cold-blooded, Flame and Frost

lineages.name: Rat-Thing
lineages.text: A little longer to grab a goblin, curios turn up more often in the Delve, and Treasure Goblins are your prey. Banes: melee, and Beasts and Fey

lineages.name: Elf
lineages.text: Now and then an extra Necronomicon Page, and you fight well with ranged weapons and against Orcs and Trolls. Bane: the Restless Dead

lineages.name: Dwarf
lineages.text: Your Delve gear wears more slowly, and you fight Burrowers and Dragons well. Banes: the sea, and ranged weapons

lineages.name: Orc
lineages.text: You hit Elite Beings harder, fight well in melee and your oath strengthens a raid. Banes: spells, and the Merchant charges you more

lineages.name: Halfling
lineages.text: Gambles fall your way a little more often, Dragons never see you coming, and you throw well. Banes: melee, and Orcs and Trolls

lineages.name: Yithian Host
lineages.text: You learn more from riddles, prophecies, bounties and dreams, and you fight well with ranged weapons. Bane: the Hounds of Tindalos hunt you

lineages.name: Mi-Go Brain Cylinder
lineages.text: A chance that a lost Delve fight costs you no wound, and the Mi-Go know their own. Banes: melee, and fishing without hands

lineages.name: Shoggoth-Touched
lineages.text: Dying in the Delve costs you less XP, and you fight Shoggoths well. Bane: relics burn you
lineages.open: earn The Floor of the Abyss

lineages.name: Leng-Folk
lineages.text: The Merchant from Leng charges you less, and you fight Flame and Frost well. Bane: the moon-beasts still own you
lineages.open: earn The Cold Plateau or The Galley Burns

lineages.name: Voormi
lineages.text: Feeding Tsathoggua counts for more, and you fight N'kai and Flame and Frost well. Bane: Deep Ones

lineages.name: K'n-yanian
lineages.text: Delve fights go your way a little more often, more so against the Underworld and Burrowers. Bane: the sea
lineages.open: earn The Deep Has a Bottom

lineages.name: Goblin
lineages.text: Won gambles pay you more Madness, and Treasure Goblins are cousins you can catch. Bane: Orcs and Trolls bully you
